verdict.rationale: Connecting a live session to a voice-agent pipeline is a fair question for a real-time streaming platform like Amazon IVS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents speech-to-text, model, or text-to-speech integration. EventBridge events, S3 recording, and the broadcast SDKs are adjacent building blocks, not a documented voice-agent integration path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the vendor documents an integration path from a live session to a voice-agent pipeline of speech-to-text, a model, and text-to-speech
